newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso still mixed on usual pre-weekend swaps.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso still mixed on usual pre-weekend swaps.

text.p: The Mexican peso remained mixed at mid-morning dealing on Thursday due to swaps ahead of the weekend, traders said.
"There is a lot of swap dealing. The spread in (Mexico and U.S.) interest rates is very good considering how stable the peso is and the positive trend in inflation," a trader said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso was 0.8 of a centavo softer at 7.9100/7.9130, while its 24-hour counterpart was 0.05 of a centavo firmer at 7.9015/7.9035 per dollar.
Same-day peso contracts had meanwhile closed trade for the day 0.6 of a centavo ahead at 7.8970/7.9020 per dollar.
